$description: Chart-language tokens for semgraph. Figma (file grafiektaal) is the source of truth: the colours, line weights and type sizes below are the Figma variables of the collection Chart and its text styles, read on 2026-10-06. color is the mode Light, the default; colorDark the mode Dark (REQ-094). Names follow the Figma variables. The few values Figma does not hold yet are marked in $sources. The service reads its style only from this file. Since 0.2.0 text is grey/700 instead of grey/800 (REQ-059: black is too hard). Since 0.3.0 the target colours and the type sizes of the KPI charts (REQ-065). Since 0.4.0 the mode Dark (REQ-094, REQ-096). Since 0.5.0 the patterns take the variables their masters are bound to in Figma (REQ-097), so they have no tokens of their own. Since 0.6.0 the type sizes of the chart cards (REQ-099, REQ-100).

mark.$description: Width in pixels of a point, per shape: a square for an amount, a diamond for a mean, a circle for a median (REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008). In Figma 10, 10 and 9 px on a 540 px chart.

figmaVariables: color and colorDark (all, modes Light and Dark); the patterns use context/light and context, as their masters in Figma (REQ-097)
figmaExamples: font.mono, size.panelKind, size.panelTitle, size.panelBody and size.panelCode (Chart card 307:328: the eyebrow, the title, the text and the SQL; REQ-099, REQ-100)
size.kpi and size.kpiDetail (Chart/KPI tile: the number and its comparison)
size.delta (Chart/KPI status: what is still needed)
